spanish: Y el holocausto presentaron a él a sus piezas y la cabeza, e hizo humear sobre el altar.

findings.issue: אֵלָיו (אל + 3ms) and לִנְתָחֶיהָ (ל + pieces + 3fs) are different prepositions and different suffixes; both become “a”, and “sus” can attach to “él” rather than to the feminine offering.

notes: Plural presenters, singular smoker, hiphil force, pieces, head, and altar match the tokens.
